title: Quietly Simmered Tunisian Borlotti Bean Tagine
description: A romantic Tunisian dish featuring borlotti beans, slow-cooked to perfection in a hot pot vessel, with a crunchy fermented twist, this kosher-friendly recipe is sure to delight, it is a hearty and comforting meal
instructions: Rinse the borlotti beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the beans, then set them aside.
Heat the olive oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked borlotti beans and enough water to cover them, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
Stir in the chopped fermented turnips and continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
